raw_segments.text: Well, then since of desires and pleasures there are some which are in kind honorable and good
Because things pleasant are divisible as we said before
Into such as our naturally objects of choice such as our naturally objects of avoidance and such as are in themselves
Indifferent money gain honor victory for instance in respect of all such and those that are indifferent
Men are blamed not merely for being affected by or desiring or liking them, but for exceeding in any way in these feelings
